spookylandsrevived.configuration.title: SpookyLandsRevived Settings
spookylandsrevived.configuration.gallows: Spawn weight of the gallows in villages. 0 disables it. Vanilla houses are about 2-4.
Chance (0.0 to 1.0) that a spot in the grid actually gets this structure. -1 = use the value from the data file.
spookylandsrevived.configuration.spacing: Average grid size in chunks. Bigger = rarer. 0 = use the value from the data file.
spookylandsrevived.configuration.separat: Minimum gap in chunks inside a grid cell. Must be smaller than spacing. 0 = use the value from the data file.
spookylandsrevived.configuration.spawnWe: How often raven flocks spawn near players: the % chance every 10 seconds (9 = about one flock every 2 minutes). 0 = ravens never spawn naturally.
spookylandsrevived.configuration.stealFr: Wild ravens swoop at players and snatch valuables from their inventory.
spookylandsrevived.configuration.raidCro: Wild ravens pull up ripe crops (also needs the mobGriefing game rule).
spookylandsrevived.configuration.rideMob: Wild ravens now and then hitch a ride on animals and villagers.
spookylandsrevived.configuration.boldCha: Chance a raven isn't scared of scarecrows and likes to sit on them. 0.01 = 1 in 100.
spookylandsrevived.configuration.soaring: Wild ravens now and then spiral up high, circle on a glide for a while, then spiral back down.
spookylandsrevived.configuration.soarHei: How high above the ground soaring ravens circle, in blocks.
spookylandsrevived.configuration.enabled: Master switch for the pet wander mode (sneak-click a tamed pet to make it wander near here instead of following you).
spookylandsrevived.configuration.include: Apply to vanilla pets (wolf, cat, parrot).
Apply to tamable animals from other mods.
spookylandsrevived.configuration.exclude: Entity IDs to leave alone, e.g. somemod:some_pet. Pack makers can also use the spookylandsrevived:no_mode_cycle entity type tag.
spookylandsrevived.configuration.wanderR: How far from its home spot a wandering pet roams, in blocks.
spookylandsrevived.configuration.require: On: sneak-click changes the mode and a plain click keeps its normal job. Off: a plain click cycles follow, sit, wander.
jei.spookylandsrevived.scarecrow: Place a scarecrow to protect your stuff. Ravens won't steal from players, pick up items, raid crops or build nests within 16 blocks of it, and any that come within 8 blocks get spooked and fly off. (Watch out for the odd bold raven: they aren't scared at all.)
jei.spookylandsrevived.raven_nest: Ravens build these on treetops and stash the loot they steal inside. Right-click a nest to take out one item at a time, or break it to spill everything. The item on top of the pile shows in the nest.
jei.spookylandsrevived.raven: Ravens steal valuables and ripe crops. Hit one to make it drop what it's carrying. Give a raven valuables to tame it (1 in 3 chance each). Tamed ravens never steal, follow you around, ride on your shoulder and bring you the odd gift. Right-click a tamed raven to make it stay or follow, or sneak-right-click to make it wander near where it is.
